newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Berjaya Group gets land use nod.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Berjaya Group gets land use nod.

text.p: Malaysia's diversified Berjaya Group Bhd said on Friday it had received approval for the conversion of a 16,451 acre plot of land from agricultural use to building and industrial use.

In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, the company said that a portion of the land, which had been earmarked for sale to two associate companies, Transwater Corporation Bhd and Berjaya Leisure Bhd, had also been freed up for general use.
The land is located in the central Malaysian state of Selangor, and the approvals were received from the state authorities.
Transwater Corp is involved in waste water treatment. Berjaya Leisure is involved in property development and gaming.
